assay_run_extension.//_measurements_help: Array of one or more measurements in this run. Expand with additional entries. censor_state comes from scripts/censor_state.py resolve_censor_state(); allowed values are listed in references/pitfalls.md section 1. Set repeated=true only for replacement measurements.
assay_run_extension.//_deviations_help: Array of protocol deviation objects. Leave empty if none. Each deviation: { 'id', 'description', 'impact', 'resolution' }.
assay_run_extension.note: execution_domain is specified for computational workflows; for a bench assay it is mapped by analogy, with the instrument's assay definition file as the script and the instrument's environmental settings as the environment variables.

extension_domain.//_extension_schema_help: URI of the JSON Schema for the SDTM extension. PLACEHOLDER until published.

sdtm_extension.//_standard_help: Declare the SDTMIG and SDTM versions used. Update if a newer version is adopted.
sdtm_extension.//_datasets_help: Declare the SDTM datasets this run produces. rows_for_this_subject depends on the number of measurements × number of supplemental qualifiers per measurement.
sdtm_extension.//_supplb_derivation_help: Map each SUPPLB qualifier to its source. Five of the six resolve in the tBCO (the specification) and are identical for every record. Only CENSOR is per-measurement, derived from the concentration against the specification's limits.
sdtm_extension.note: The analytical limits are standard LB variables (LBLLOD, LBLLOQ, LBULOQ) and resolve in the specification. Of the four supplemental qualifiers, ASSAYNAM and ASSAYPLT resolve in the specification, RBCOID in this run, and CENSOR is derived per measurement against the specification's limits.
